verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud has a published pricing page (daily.co/pricing/pipecat-cloud) that describes agent profiles, concurrency and a Krisp add-on, so a pricing structure is publicly documented. The evidence does not show any actual per-minute or usage rates, so cost per call cannot be estimated from what is cited. missing for 10: quoted per-minute/usage rates, a per-profile price breakdown, a cost-per-call estimation method or calculator, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
